title: fix(app-shell): the Studio copilot draws no pending-drafts bar over its composer (objectui#12965, part of objectui#12725)
body:
Fixes #12965
Clause-②: no

Part of #12725. This is a draft by a dispatched developer; the seat `repo:cloud#2` lands it. Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`.

## What changes

In the package's own Studio, `ChatPane` (`packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`) no longer mounts `PendingDraftsBar`. In the Studio copilot's right slot, the floating bar (「有 1 项改动尚未发布… 发布」, absolute at `bottom-20`, objectui#5694) sat over the composer's input line and hid the placeholder and the first typed line. There, the top bar's 变更 and 发布 and the applied card's 查看变更并发布 are the ways to review and publish, and #12725's ruled StudioRailCopilot artboard draws no bar.

- **The condition is a reading `ChatPane` already makes.** `onBoundPackageStudio` is `studioChangesReviewTarget(boundPackageId, location).replace`: the applied card's review door (`reviewDrafts`, PR #12964) replaces the history entry exactly when the location is already on that package's Studio pillar. The Studio copilot is mounted only on `/studio/:packageId/:tab` with `editPackageId` set to that package, so `boundPackageId` is that package there. The full-page chat (`/ai/...`) and the console dock (`ConsoleLayout`, `/apps/...`) are never on such a pillar.
- **Unchanged:** `PendingDraftsBar` itself, its placement and its behaviour outside Studio; no `packages/plugin-chatbot/**` file; no new prop anywhere; the top bar's 变更 badge and the applied card.
- **Docs:** one sentence in the "Studio Copilot Drafts" row of `content/docs/guide/console.md` (AGENTS.md #2).
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/12965-studio-copilot-no-drafts-bar.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Measured (live, zh-CN, the real `build` agent, one pending draft)

The driver is #12725 phase 6's, with the agent named `build` so `isBuildSurface` is true; only the reading is new. It records the composer textarea's box, the bar's box and their overlap. It also records what `document.elementFromPoint` finds at five points along the textarea's first text line, where the placeholder is drawn.

| reading | bar | overlap with the textarea | first-line points on the composer | 变更 badge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Studio 1010, before (`main` at `43efd078`) | shown | 267 by 51 px | 0 of 5 (all the bar) | 1 |
| Studio 1280, before | shown | 327 by 51 px | 0 of 5 (all the bar) | 1 |
| Studio 1010, after | not drawn | none | 5 of 5 | 1 |
| Studio 1280, after | not drawn | none | 5 of 5 | 1 |
| Full-page 1280, before and after (control) | shown | 670 by 51 px | 0 of 5 | n/a |

After the fix, the placeholder 「问问数据，或让我改改这个应用…」 measures 208 px in the textarea's font, against 273 px (1010) and 333 px (1280) of content width, so it shows whole. The full-page control gives the same reading before and after.

## Tests

`packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.studioDraftsBar-12965.test.tsx`, 3 tests. The harness is phase 6's: the real `ChatPane` and the real `PendingDraftsBar`, with `ChatbotEnhanced` stubbed. `_drafts` answers one draft for the bound package in every case.

- On one of the package's Studio pillars, no `pending-drafts-bar` is drawn. A sibling probe reads the same ledger through `usePendingDrafts`, the hook the Studio top bar's 变更 badge uses. The probe must answer 1 before the bar's absence is read, so the absence is not read before the ledger has answered.
- CONTROL, two hosts: the full-page chat (`/ai/build/conv-1?package=app.hcpl`) and the console dock's location (`/apps/hcpl/hcpl_borrowing`) still draw the bar.
- No layout runs in the test. The unobstructed input line is the live reading above.

Run: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.studioDraftsBar-12965.test.tsx --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 3 passed (3)`.

**Ablation** (once, on the condition; the fix committed first as `ac7edbc6`). It went through `ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode: anchor `{isBuildSurface && !onBoundPackageStudio ? (` replaced by `{isBuildSurface ? (`. The anchor went from 1 hit to 0 and the blob from `02504bbffb97` to `1f902a32a34a`. The same run went red as expected: `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`, the Studio case failing on `queryByTestId('pending-drafts-bar')` (it expected null and got the bar's DIV), both controls green. Restore: the blob after restore equals HEAD (`02504bbffb97`), `git diff HEAD` is empty, and an on-disk `grep -c` of the anchor reads 1. The ablation was one-off; no permanent file was added for it.

**`@object-ui/app-shell` full suite**, at `ac7edbc6` (the head of this PR), in 12 shards through the verify lock (`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --shard=K/12 packages/app-shell/`). Every shard reported `VERDICT command-exit 0`. In total: `Test Files 1570 passed | 1 skipped (1571)`, which equals the 1571 tracked app-shell test files (`git ls-files` at the same head); `Tests 14761 passed | 9 skipped (14770)`; 0 failed.

## Gates

Local, each exit code captured before any pipe:

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): VERDICT command-exit 0, 0 `error TS`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new test file.
- eslint on the two changed source and test files: exit 0, 0 errors. Warnings on `AiChatPage.tsx`: 34 at base, 34 at head. The new test file has 0.
- Exit 0: `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:doc-json` (after the closure build; before it, exit 2, PREREQUISITE, the strict face unbuilt), `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `changeset:check`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.
- NOT MEASURED locally: `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` (exit 2, PREREQUISITE: a scoped build of the 34 packages the covered documents import). The docs change is one table-row sentence with no code fence. CI runs both.

objectui has no `dispatch-gates.mjs`. The list above is the root `package.json` `check:*` scripts whose scan roots read `app-shell` source, test files, `.changeset/` or `content/docs`, the same derivation as PR #12964. CI's check-runs are the merge gate.

## Evidence

Branch `claude/issue-12965-evidence` at `df567c61`, `evidence/12965/` (never merged): six screenshots (Studio 1010 and 1280, before and after; full-page 1280, before and after), the six JSON readings, the driver and a README.

## Deviations

- **File surface:** the claim names `AiChatPage.tsx`, tests beside it and a changeset. The PR also adds one sentence to `content/docs/guide/console.md` (AGENTS.md #2). Nothing else.
- **The condition is keyed on the bound package's own Studio, not on "any Studio".** The two agree for every host today, since the Studio copilot always passes its own package as `editPackageId`. Keying on the bound package reuses the one predicate the applied card's door already reads instead of writing a second path test.

## Acceptance notes

- **Seen on the way, not changed (the card keeps the bar outside Studio):** on the full-page chat (`/ai/build?package=...`) at 1280 px, with the build agent and one pending draft, the same bar also sits over the composer's first line: overlap 670 by 51 px, all five first-line points on the bar (`before-fullpage-1280-draft-pending.png` on the evidence branch). The console dock was not measured. This is reported to the seat in the dev report, for #12724's scope (the full-page AI build chat and its composer).
